sections.name: Getting Started
sections.description: Install Jetonomy, run the setup wizard, and launch your WordPress forum or Q&A community in minutes.

sections.name: How-To Guides
sections.description: Step-by-step recipes for the things community owners do most: launch a support forum, run a members-only community, collect feature requests, invite members, and more.

sections.name: Spaces & Categories
sections.description: Organize your community into categories and Forum, Q&A, Ideas, or Feed spaces with membership and join controls.

sections.name: Discussions & Topics
sections.description: Create topics, post threaded replies, upvote and downvote, accept answers, and save drafts in your community.

sections.name: Search & Discovery
sections.description: Help members find discussions with full-text search, cross-space tags, and filters.

sections.name: Moderation & Trust
sections.description: Keep your community safe with trust levels 0 to 5, content flagging, a moderation queue, anti-spam, and member banning.

sections.name: Notifications & Email
sections.description: Bring members back with in-app notifications, email alerts, and Pro private messaging, digests, and web push.

sections.name: User Profiles & Leaderboard
sections.description: Member profiles, reputation scores, online status, and a leaderboard that ranks your top contributors.

sections.name: Mobile App
sections.description: Give your community a native iOS and Android app. Brand it from wp-admin (logo, color, community name), connect members with WordPress Application Passwords, and publish your own branded build.

sections.name: Pro Features
sections.description: Jetonomy Pro extensions: private messaging, polls, reactions, custom badges, advanced moderation, analytics, webhooks, and AI.

sections.name: Integrations
sections.description: Gate spaces with MemberPress, Paid Memberships Pro, WooCommerce, LearnDash, and Tutor LMS, and connect BuddyPress and FluentCommunity.

sections.name: Admin Settings
sections.description: Configure permissions, email, appearance, SEO, anti-spam, access control, and the activity log from wp-admin.

sections.name: Migration
sections.description: Import your existing forum from bbPress, wpForo, or Asgaros Forum without losing topics, replies, or members.

sections.name: Why Jetonomy
sections.description: How Jetonomy compares to bbPress, wpForo, Asgaros Forum, and other community platforms, and how it scales to communities with thousands of topics.

sections.name: Troubleshooting
sections.description: Fix a member who cannot post, a community page that 404s, email that is not arriving, or an integration that stopped granting access - plus every Jetonomy error message and what it means.

sections.name: FAQ
sections.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Jetonomy and Jetonomy Pro, grouped by topic.

sections.name: Developer Guide
sections.description: Extend Jetonomy with the REST API, hooks, WP-CLI, blocks, shortcodes, and template overrides.
